seller_message:
Hi, I'm interested in your 1977 Porsche 911S Targa. I'm considering a trip to see it and had a few questions first.

You mentioned that fourth gear doesn't engage. Does it grind, pop out, or refuse to select? Has anyone diagnosed the linkage or 915 transmission, and do you have a repair estimate?

Has the 2.7L engine had any rebuild or head-stud work? Are there records for recent engine and gearbox service, and are there any known oil leaks or overheating issues?

Would you mind sending a few additional photos of:
• The underside, floors, rockers, jack points, and battery area
• The engine bay, engine underside, and any visible oil leaks
• The transmission and shifter area
• The Targa roof, seals, and door jambs
• The VIN plate and any rust or damage

If convenient, a cold-start video and a short driving video showing the available gears would also help. Would you be comfortable with an independent pre-purchase inspection?

Thanks very much — I appreciate your time!
